**Finding 1 (high, plan-lock secondary messaging not implemented)** — Wired a best-effort, non-blocking release-impact advisory into `_plan_lock_main` (`scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/cli.py:2127` and below). Added `_emit_plan_lock_release_impact_advisory(plan_dir)` plus `_git_changed_paths_for_lock(plan_dir)`: the helper walks ancestors for `.git`, runs `git diff --name-only HEAD` and `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` (5s timeout, silent on any failure), loads the plan with `plan_loader.load`, extracts `surfaces` / `child_charter.allowed_paths` / step path tokens, calls `release_impact.analyze(...)`, and prints the rendered text under a `[release-impact]` prefix with no sidecar.
